### Cobb County Sheriff’s Office + Safety Cloud®: Weaving Safety into the Fabric of the Community

The community wanted Craig Owens to be Sheriff of Cobb County, GA before he even realized he wanted it. Once he stepped into the role, he took on the responsibility of serving all criminal and civil warrants, becoming keeper of the county jail, and answering calls for service.

On top of everything that his job requires of him, the Sheriff must also keep every employee that operates one of those vehicles safe. He decided to turn to [Safety Cloud by HAAS Alert](https://www.haasalert.com/safety-cloud) to make that happen.

Read the Cobb County Sheriff’s Office case study to learn how the Sheriff’s Office added additional protection for their deputies, including key details on:

- Easily implementing digital alerting on any law enforcement vehicle
- Safety Cloud-equipped vehicles leading to [a safer community](https://www.haasalert.com/blog/improve-community-safety-police-technology)
- Improving Move Over law compliance with local drivers
